title: Portfolio
subtitle: My Projects
description: Here are some of my projects that showcase my skills and dedication to web development and other computer science fields. Click on each project to learn more about the process, technologies used, and challenges overcome.

investbit.name: Investbit
investbit.description: Investbit is a website that serve as a learning platform through the presence of learn page that provide basic explanation about stocks, how to analyze stocks, and some terms related to IDX (Indonesia Stock Exchange) and glossary page that provide explanation about specialized terms in the world of stock investment. This platform also provides mutual fund performance page that show the top performers, leaderboard, and detailed analytics. Furthermore, the system includes a dashboard that can be used by admin to manage content related to mutual fund, such as categories, items, and records (store daily and YTD yield on each day). I used Next.js as the frontend and backend framework, Tailwind CSS as the styling tool, and Supabase as the open-source database management to develop this website.
features: Public Page: Learn, glossary, and mutual fund performance (top performers, leaderboard, and detailed analytics)
Dashboard: Content management for mutual fund categories, items, and records

gamification-website.name: Gamification Website
gamification-website.description: A gamification-based learning website to improve student motivation, engagement, and learning outcomes in a digital learning environment aligned with the Indonesian national curriculum. The platform successfully integrated key gamification elements, such as points, experience (XP), levels, challenges, and leaderboards, which meet the needs of both students and teachers. Furthermore, the system includes an analytics dashboard that helps teachers monitor student progress and make data-driven decisions. We used Next.js as the frontend framework, Nest.js as the backend framework, Tailwind CSS as the styling tool, and Supabase as the open-source database management to develop this website.
features: Main Page: Activities, leaderboards, activity history, and a user profile
Student Dashboard: View pending tasks, recent activities, student classes, task progress, submission progress, task analytics, and leaderboard ranking
Teacher Dashboard: View recent submissions, recent activities, class management, task management, review of class task submissions, task analytics, and leaderboard ranking

Admin Dashboard: Platform monitoring, a task popularity leaderboard, a chart of students per class, recent activities, task management, and system configuration for subject, material, task, and task type

my-react-app.name: My React App
my-react-app.description: This project serves as a learning source for me to enhance my skill in using React to develop a website. This is an all in one productivity app where user can manage their to-do lists, shopping cart, and track their expense. I use React JS and Tailwind CSS to develop this website.

spotify-clone-app.name: Spotify Clone App
spotify-clone-app.description: This project is a clone spotify app where we can control track in our spotify website. This website use spotify API to achieve this functionality. In this website we can view our spotify account's playlists and tracks. We also can choose which track can be played, handle skip to previous or next track, handle pause or play track, and handle the track volumes. I use React JS and TailwindCSS to develop this website.

inspira-umkm.name: InspiraUMKM
inspira-umkm.description: This project is a website that serves as a marketplace for packaging, banner, and sticker designs. We developed this project to help enhance the value of UMKM stores. By using our designs, we aim to help their stores achieve better visual appeal. We used Laravel as the framework and Bootstrap as the styling tool to develop this website.
features: Provide ratings for products that have been purchased (buyer)

pustaka-bekas.name: PustakaBekas
pustaka-bekas.description: This project is a website that serves as a marketplace for secondhand books. We developed this project as an effort to raise awareness about reusing secondhand products that are still in great condition. This marketplace supports normal transactions and trades, which is the key feature of this website. Users can trade books with each other as long as both books have prices within a 10% price range. We use Laravel as the framework and Bootstrap as the styling tools to develop this website.
features: Provide ratings for products that have been purchased (buyer)

passenger-monitoring-models-at-bus-stop.name: Passengers Monitoring Models at Bus Stop
passenger-monitoring-models-at-bus-stop.description: This project serves to monitor the number of people at Transjakarta bus stop, precisely at S.Parman Transjakarta bus stop. This project  was developed using Python and we utilize a computer vision algorithm called the YOLOv3 algorithm to build the entire model. This project mainly focuses on examining  or analyzing which time and day have the highest amount of  people,number which may provide essential data regarding the density pattern in Jakarta bus stops.

nitip-donk.name: NITIP DONK
nitip-donk.description: NITIP DONK is a food pickup website that serves to help people order food or drinks from anytime and anywhere. This website was developed using React Vite, Typescript, and Vanilla CSS for styling. This project utilized scrum as the development life cycle. I contribute as the development team, precisely as the frontend developer.

code-reengineering.name: Code Reengineering
code-reengineering.description: This website serve to provide materials regarding code smells, such as change preventer and the dispensables. This project was developed using HTML, Vanilla CSS, and JS.

hi-toyz.name: HI-Toyz
hi-toyz.description: HI-Toyz is a website that serves to sell toys and provide information regarding the store’s detailed information. This website was developed using HTML, Vanilla CSS, and JS.

dog-care.name: DOG CARE
dog-care.description: DOG CARE is a website that serves to provide information about various dog breeds and provide consultation with a vet. This website was developed using HTML, Vanilla CSS, and JS. I contribute as the UI/UX designer on this project. I faced many problems during this project since this is the first project that I am working on, but I could overcome this problem by watching tutorials on the internet and asking for my friends help.
features: View information about various dog breeds
